sentence.text: $250,000.00 (25.00%) of the $1,000,000.00 total is held in sleeves this table does not itemise, because the sleeve holds cash only or its detail is withheld.
sentence.drawn_at: unlistedSleevesWords() (line 297, text) printed by UnlistedSleevesNote (data-slot security-unlisted-sleeves) at lines 478 (no securities at all) and 538 (under the table), inside the Securities panel; navy ink, max-w 720px, no new band or colour

amount_rule: The card's total less the listed rows, from the served nodes the page holds: snapshot.custodyTotalAmount (the figure the Total Assets card shows) minus the sum of node.amount over the table's rows (securityRowsFrom: every node of kind 'security', a producer CASH node included, whose amount is not zero), taken before the Sleeve/Account selects and the per-security fold (neither changes a sum). Rounded to the cent; the sentence shows only when the result is above 0.01. Share = amount / custodyTotalAmount. With an account picked the snapshot in hand is that account's one-account answer, so the same rule runs over that account. No sentence when custodyTotalAmount is absent or not above zero, when a listed row has a null amount (the gap is then unknown and is not guessed), or under a Sleeve or Account choice in the table. No new request.
node_says_reason: No. A served node marks a withheld drill (the 'DRILL WITHHELD' capability fact, classification.capabilityFacts on the sleeve), but nothing marks a sleeve as cash only (the producer's cash-only sleeve carries no mark, and its CASH child is itself a listed row on this page). The sentence therefore names both reasons without apportioning, and says so here. See row DSGN_IRPTV1-D2-W60-S3.
